title: CollectionService:GetTagged()
summary: Returns every instance currently carrying a tag — instantly, no hierarchy scanning. Pair with GetInstanceAddedSignal to also catch future taggings.

reference.returns: Array of all instances with that tag right now.

explanation.whatItIs: 'Everyone wearing the red badge, step forward.' Instant group retrieval by tag.
explanation.whyItExists: Replaces fragile GetDescendants scans with a maintained index.
whenToUse: Initial setup loops over existing tagged instances
Any 'all X' question where X is a tag
whenNotToUse: Without also handling FUTURE tags — combine with GetInstanceAddedSignal
tips: Canonical pattern: for loop over GetTagged + Connect(GetInstanceAddedSignal) — both
Tag name constants in a shared module prevent typo drift
commonMistakes: Only handling existing instances — late-tagged objects never initialize
Only handling the signal — existing instances at script start are missed

examples.title: Both-halves pattern
examples.code:
local CS = game:GetService("CollectionService")

local function initCoin(coin)
    -- one-time setup
end

for _, coin in CS:GetTagged("Coin") do   -- existing
    initCoin(coin)
end
CS:GetInstanceAddedSignal("Coin"):Connect(initCoin)   -- future
